support.quote: The novel, Bomber (1970), generally reckoned to be the first novel written using a word processor, was a huge success; the computer was an IBM MT/ST
The novel, Bomber (1970), generally reckoned to be the first novel written using a word processor, was a huge success; the computer was an IBM MT/ST
In 1970 Deighton wrote Bomber, a fictional account of an RAF Bomber Command raid that goes wrong. To produce the novel he used an IBM MT/ST
Bomber was the first novel to be written on a word processor, the IBM MT/ST.
Remember DOS? I use WordStar 4.0 as my word-processing system.

assessments.note: Martin said this on the US chat show Conan (May 2014); the BBC reported it — it was not a BBC interview

support.quote: As of 2020, fantasy author George R. R. Martin used the MS-DOS version of WordStar 4.0.
